definitions.explanation: Women's shoes with tall, narrow heels. A loanword from English 'high heel.' Usually used in the singular form even when referring to a pair.

examples.japanese: ハイヒールで{長時間|ちょうじかん}{歩|ある}くと{足|あし}が{疲|つか}れる。
examples.english: Walking in high heels for a long time tires out your feet.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}に{合|あ}わせて{新|あたら}しいハイヒールを{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to buy new high heels to match the wedding.

notes:
Loanword from English 'high heel.' In Japanese, the singular form is typically used to refer to the pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハイヒールを{履|は}く: put on / wear high heels
- ハイヒールを{脱|ぬ}ぐ: take off high heels
- ハイヒールで{歩|ある}く: walk in high heels
- {高|たか}いハイヒール: high-heeled shoes (with tall heels)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パンプス: pumps — closed-toe heels, often with a lower heel
- ヒール: heel — informal short form; can refer to the heel itself or the shoe style
